depthwindow.mode.window.tooltip: Moving your head moves the view behind the screen, like looking through a real window. Turning your head does nothing.
depthwindow.mode.window_and_head_look.to: Window effect, plus turning your head turns the view (amplified, so your eyes can stay on the screen). Your aim stays where the mouse points.
depthwindow.options.title: Depth Window Settings
depthwindow.options.key_hint.recenter: %s Recenter: your current pose becomes "straight ahead"
depthwindow.options.key_hint.toggle: %s Turn the effect on or off
depthwindow.options.key_hint.status: %s Show or hide the status overlay
depthwindow.options.recenter_now.tooltip: Sit how you normally play and look at the middle of the screen, then click.
depthwindow.options.controls.tooltip: Rebind keys (look for the Depth Window category).
depthwindow.options.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. Same as the toggle key.
depthwindow.options.yaw_gain.tooltip: How much the view turns per degree you turn your head left or right.
depthwindow.options.pitch_gain.tooltip: How much the view turns per degree you tilt your head up or down.
depthwindow.options.deadzone.tooltip: Head turns smaller than this are ignored, so the view doesn't wobble when you sit still.
depthwindow.options.max_turn.tooltip: The furthest the view can turn away from where you are aiming.
depthwindow.options.strength.tooltip: Amplifies head movement for the window effect. 1.0 is physically correct, 0 turns the window effect off.
depthwindow.options.window_distance.tool: How far away (in blocks) the virtual glass is. Things at this distance stay still; closer things pop out of the screen, further things sit behind it.
depthwindow.options.smoothing.tooltip: Extra smoothing. Higher is steadier but reacts later.
depthwindow.options.crosshair.tooltip: Moves the crosshair so it stays on the block you would actually hit.
depthwindow.options.third_person.tooltip: Also apply the window effect in third-person views. Head look only works in first person.
depthwindow.options.auto_recenter.toolti: Recenter automatically when the tracker first connects after starting the game.
depthwindow.options.status_hud.tooltip: Show tracking numbers in the top-left corner. Same as the status key.
depthwindow.options.reset.tooltip: Resets the settings in this menu. Keeps your calibration (screen size, recentered position).
